prompt: The image is rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, capturing the bustling activity of a shipyard dock. On the far left stands a tall crane operator in a yellow hard hat, leaning out of his cab to look down at the scene below. Directly beneath him on the left rests a large rusted anchor chain, coiled loosely on the wooden planks. Next to the chain sits a weary sailor in a blue striped shirt, tying his boot laces with focused attention. To the right of the sailor, a brown dog sniffs at a discarded fish head lying on the ground. In the center foreground, a woman in a green apron hands a heavy wrench to a mechanic wearing oil-stained overalls. The mechanic takes the tool while balancing on one leg, his other foot resting on a wooden crate. Behind them in the center, a stack of three wooden barrels leans precariously against a metal pillar. A seagull perches atop the highest barrel, preening its white feathers. To the right of the barrels, a young boy in a cap points excitedly toward the water. His mother, wearing a floral dress, looks at him with a gentle smile while holding a small paper bag. Near the water's edge on the right, an old fisherman in a raincoat casts a net into the dark harbor. Beside him stands a rusty bicycle with a broken seat, leaning against a lamppost. A black cat sleeps on the bicycle seat, curled into a tight ball. Further back on the right, two dockworkers in matching gray uniforms lift a heavy crate together, their muscles tensed with effort. Above them, a flock of five distant birds flies in formation across the pale sky. In the background, a large cargo ship with a red hull dominates the horizon, its smokestack emitting a faint wisp of gray. There is no modern smartphone visible in anyone's hand. There is no bright neon signage on the buildings. There is no clear blue sky without clouds.
